test_item:
Call service do the certificate verification.
(service returns OK for an unchanged certificate file)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. An ECU certificate chain is present on the DUT
proc:
1. Read the ECU certificate status file on the DUT
$ adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/ecu/state/ecucertstatus
er: 1. The adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/ecu/state/ecucertstatus output shows the status value
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SYSAD_SEC_ECUCERT_ECUCERT_SERVICE Requirement Description and Verification Criteria
sibling axis: verification status; rule 1,3 of SEC-04 4.2
channel_feasible: Y/Y
path per ECU Cert Test Steps PDF 20260826; CCVR v2.7 working note 20260915 states /mnt/vendor/ecuidentity/... as primary — confirm with Samuel (A-SEC-16)
